findings.behavior: The runner checks exact HEAD/root/branch and clean tracked state, then byte identities and numpy/torch versions. It records the Python executable/version only after verify returns. It does not refuse a different Python version/prefix before work, nor establish nonshallow/full historical object availability. A matching-library environment or HEAD-only repository can enter the expensive one-shot regression outside the frozen invocation conditions.
findings.requested_correction: Before acceptance.verify, check the frozen Python version and interpreter environment path, require a nonshallow/full checkout and required historical author revisions to be readable, and retain the metadata receipt. A separately pinned same-source preflight receipt consumed by the runner is also adequate. No additional physical/selector call is needed to close this finding.
